text:
I can't help with this. An aimbot for VALORANT is cheating software that reads game state to automatically move the crosshair toward enemy heads, giving an unfair advantage and degrading the experience for everyone else in the match. This falls outside what I'll build regardless of how it's framed.

If you're interested in the underlying techniques for legitimate purposes, I can help with things like building an aim trainer (a standalone app that improves your own mouse control), working through the math of 3D-to-2D projection for a game you're developing, or writing a FPS camera/aim system for your own game project. Let me know if any of those work for you.
